scripts.install:all: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml exec yarzawin-api npm install && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml exec yarzawin-web npm install
scripts.build:docker: npm run install:all && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml build
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml exec yarzawin-api npm run test:e2e
scripts.db:reset: docker exec -i yarzawin-postgres psql -U yarzawin_user -d yarzawin < apps/yarzawin-api/src/database/sql/schema.sql
